recipes.title: Create the file in the Files explorer

steps.say: Open the Files tab at the top of the workbench.
Press New File (or right-click a folder and choose New File).
Type the full path, folders included: {1}
Write the contents the task asks for in the editor on the right.
Press Save (or Ctrl+S). The dot for unsaved changes disappears.

recipes.verify: The file appears in the tree, and the terminal sees it too: try ls or cat.

recipes.title: Edit the file in the Files explorer

steps.say: Open the Files tab at the top of the workbench.
Expand the folders and click the file {1}. Use Filter files if the tree is long.
Change the contents in the editor exactly as the task says.
Press Save (or Ctrl+S). An unsaved file is not seen by the checker.

recipes.verify: Reopen the file: your change is still there after Refresh.

recipes.title: Run the statement in the query editor

steps.say: Open the query editor tab at the top of the workbench.
Write the statement in the editor. Table names must match exactly, e.g. {1}.
Read the result grid below the editor and compare it with what the task asks.

recipes.verify: The result grid shows the rows the task describes.

recipes.title: Build it in the web playground

steps.say: Write the code the task asks for.
Press Run to render the page in the result pane.
Look at the result and check it matches the task.

recipes.verify: Run saves the code too, so Check my work grades what you see.
